This is a judgement from priors about how MLPs train with Adam. I did not run or look up any data.

- **Claims 3, 4, 21:** With a high learning rate, larger batches stabilise training, shallower nets diverge less, and stepping the rate down helps a lot. I rate these most likely.
- **Claim 22:** Widening gains most when the net is narrow.
- **Alpha, batch size, depth and width claims:** These have weak or ambiguous reasons to depend on the condition, so I kept them near 30–40.
